text:
Hannah Cole: Heads-up  samplegen flagged a failing example in optimize/batching.md and a Rust snippet in optimize/kv-prefetch.rs that doesn't compile. CI link: https://ci.internal.redwood/optkit/5421/logs
Vikram Shah: Saw that. The batching.md JS snippet uses `batchSize` but our SDK now expects `maxBatch`. Quick rename should fix. Also there's a comment about recommending per-p99 sizing, maybe add a one-line heuristic.
Priya Rao: Rust failure is `use rd::OldClient;` -> OldClient removed in v2. I can update to `rd::Client::new_with_api_key` and adjust the example lifetime annotations.
doc-bot: [automated] samplegen run: branch docs/optkit-quickfix shows 2 failing examples: optimize/batching.md (js), optimize/kv-prefetch.rs (rust). Suggested fixes: replace batchSize->maxBatch, update Rust constructor.
Hannah Cole: Can we add a tiny compile check to examples/test_examples.rs so future changes catch this?
Priya Rao: I'll add a compile-only test that pulls the code fence and compiles it using cargo check. Will push in a tiny PR along with the snippet fix.
Vikram Shah: I'll update batching.md and add a short heuristic blurb: "Start with maxBatch = min(64, ceil(throughput/avg_tokens_per_request)) and tune for p95 latency." Keep it short.
Marta Gomez: Can someone also scan for broken quant-profile anchors? Last week we had a renamed anchor and a 404 in one of the snippets.
Hannah Cole: Good catch. I grepped the repo and found one reference to /optimize/quant-profiles-old in optimize/kv-prefetch.md. I'll update to /optimize/quant-profiles#quant-profiles-table and add a migration note: "If following older links, see redirect at top of quant-profiles."
Priya Rao: Pushed PR #4310: Rust snippet fix + compile test.
Vikram Shah: Pushed PR #4311: JS rename + heuristic note + tweak to example to show `maxBatch` usage.
doc-bot: [automated] CI queued for PRs #4310 and #4311.
Hannah Cole: Once CI passes, merge and then I'll create DOCS-859 to run a quick grep audit for old constructor names and outdated anchors across optimize/. Assign to docs-rotation.
Marta Gomez: Thanks team  also add a short changelog line so customers know examples updated for SDK v2.
Hannah Cole: Will do. Closing thread after merges.
